sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
RTape is recognized as the world's leading manufacturer of application tape and premasks for the sign, screen printing and digital printing marketplaces.

Industry: Manufacturing · Size: <$50M · Products: RTape Conform with RLA, RTape ApliTape, RTape Clear Choice, RTape Premask and Prespacing Tapes, RTape Blue Block Out, RTape HotMask

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: RTape scores 30 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by pain-point alignment (10/15). Nothing was found for event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on weatherability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (34% similar on films, graphic, media, printing); Drytac (29% similar on media, films, print, graphic); ORAFOL Europe (22% similar on films, graphic, digital, printing). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
